notes.zh: MOSA 0.2.1-rc.14 桌面测试发布包。支持批量拖放导入与原生拖出，Web Capture 配对需用户确认，并加固本地存储与 Windows 更新回滚。
notes.en: MOSA 0.2.1-rc.14 desktop test release. Adds batched drag-drop import and native drag-out, requires explicit Web Capture pairing consent, and hardens local store writes plus Windows update rollback.
